title: The Statistical Cost of Second-Order Orthogonality
abstract: arXiv:2611.25702v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Debiased machine learning removes the first-order effect of nuisance estimation, but the remaining quadratic bias can invalidate inference when nuisance functions are hard to learn. Second-order orthogonal moments remove this bias at the cost of additional variance. We characterize this cost as the minimum variance of a correction that offsets the quadratic sensitivity of the moment to nuisance errors, and show that exact correction is possible only when this cost is finite. Because the cost varies across moments, the first-order efficient moment need not minimize total variance. We therefore choose the moment and its correction jointly, and derive the resulting minimum variance, a second-order analogue of the semiparametric efficiency bound. translated_title: 二阶正交性的统计代价
translated_abstract: 去偏机器学习能够消除干扰参数估计的一阶效应，但当干扰函数难以学习时，剩余的二阶偏差可能导致统计推断失效。二阶正交矩可以消除这种偏差，但其代价是引入额外的方差。我们将这一代价刻画为某种修正所需的最小方差，该修正用于抵消矩对干扰误差的二阶敏感性，并证明只有当这一代价有限时才能实现精确修正。由于该代价在不同矩之间存在差异，一阶有效的矩未必能使总方差最小化。因此，我们联合选择矩及其修正方案，并推导出由此得到的最小方差，即半参数效率界的二阶类似物。最优矩可能以牺牲一阶效率为代价，换取更低的修正成本。在一个二元选择logit模型中，最优矩仅在协变量样本充足（分布密集）的区域才使用条件似然之外的信息……
tldr: 该论文将二阶正交矩消除二阶偏差的代价刻画为修正项的最小方差，并通过联合优化矩选择与修正方案，推导出半参数效率界的二阶类似物，证明最优矩可能牺牲一阶效率以降低修正成本。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the statistical cost of second-order orthogonal moments as the minimum variance of a correction offsetting quadratic bias, and by jointly optimizing the moment and its correction, derives a second-order analogue of the semiparametric efficiency bound, showing the optimal moment may trade first-order efficiency for lower correction cost.
